question: How many products are in the Electronics category?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

question: How many orders have the status 'cancelled'?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the average list price of the products in the Books category?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products WHERE category = 'Books'

question: What is the total revenue from customer 12?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = 12

question: How many orders were placed by customers who live in Dhaka?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Dhaka'

question: How many units of the 'Wireless Mouse' have been sold in total?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Wireless Mouse'

question: Which product category earned the most revenue?
expected_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which city has the most customers?
expected_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product has sold the most units?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the name of the customer who has spent the most money in total?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average order value?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(v) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS v FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: What is the average order value, and by what percent is it above the value of the smallest order?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(v), (AVG(v) - MIN(v)) * 100.0 / MIN(v) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS v FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)
